trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 140 degrees and shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Relatively smooth linear boundary with low-amplitude micro-serrations; significant high-contrast pixel irregularities and jagged protrusions are localized at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a symmetrical convex curve from the median notch extending to the lateral vertices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive stippling pattern comprising small, high-intensity white pixel clusters scattered across the dark dorsal surface; dense, high-contrast clusters at the far left and right fluke tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, irregular geometric growth at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread high-intensity white speckling across the dark grey/black dorsal fluke surface.
